mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version numbering scheme

The project's current recorded decision is to use Semantic Versioning (semver) for version numbers. The stated reason is that API compatibility matters much more to the project than publication dates, so version numbers should communicate compatibility rather than release timing.
EOF
cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md
